pairs.subject: engine-binding-surface
pairs.evidence: crates/engine/src/invocation/run.rs:23 This context reaches the Claude, Codex, contree and docker CLIs as separate OS processes (std::process::Command, stdin/stdout byte pipes), not as foreign libraries loaded in-process. A grep of the whole crates/engine tree for extern "C", MaybeUninit, PhantomPinned, PhantomData, transmute and NonNull found nothing, so there is no foreign memory model, address-sensitive object, foreign class hierarchy or thread-bound foreign release for the binding-surface techniques to govern.

techniques.evidence: crates/engine/src/invocation/run.rs:123 Only child processes are spawned. No host-allocated structure has its address handed to a foreign runtime, and there is no MaybeUninit or PhantomPinned anywhere in the engine crate.

crates/engine/src/sandbox/contree.rs:32 The only thread_local gives each worker thread a session-slot integer. It is not a cached answer from a foreign runtime to a safety-critical question, and no destructor reads it.
